name: sar-geo
description: Search and rescue planning on CalTopo maps: terrain, hasty lines, landing zones, the way out, hospitals and urban assignments.
long_description:
SAR Geo gives Claude the sar-geo-mcp tools: read CalTopo maps, stage terrain around a place last seen, list hasty search candidates, parking, helicopter landing zones, exits and the nearest hospitals, plan urban assignments, and export GeoJSON files CalTopo imports as draft assignments. It never writes to CalTopo.

The extension updates itself: each time Claude Desktop starts it, it runs the newest release from PyPI. Ask Claude "check for a sar-geo update" to see which version you have. Every key in the settings is optional; ask Claude "what's my sar-geo key status?" to see what each one unlocks.

Ask Claude to save a file and it goes in Documents/sar_geo, one folder per chat, and opens in Finder or Explorer. Downloaded terrain is cached out of the way in your system's cache folder.

wms_token.title: CalTopo WMS token
wms_token.description: Optional. Six characters from CalTopo: click your name, then Your Account, API Access, and copy the part between /api/ and /wms in the WMS link. Turns on terrain pictures, the canopy panel and landing-zone imagery.

caltopo_id.title: CalTopo credential ID
caltopo_id.description: Optional. Only needed for private or team maps. From CalTopo: Your Account, Credentials (12 characters). A read-only team credential is enough.

caltopo_key.title: CalTopo credential key
caltopo_key.description: Optional. The key that goes with the credential ID above.

caltopo_account_id.title: CalTopo account ID
caltopo_account_id.description: Optional. Six characters, from Your Account. Only needed for printing PDFs through CalTopo.

mapbox_token.title: Mapbox token
mapbox_token.description: Optional. Adds Mapbox satellite pictures to landing zones. Free from account.mapbox.com.

google_maps_key.title: Google Maps key (advanced)
google_maps_key.description: Optional. Adds Google satellite pictures to landing zones. Needs the Maps Static API; Google's terms limit how these images may be used.

exports_folder.title: Exports folder
exports_folder.description: Where files you ask to save go, one subfolder per chat (for example Documents/sar_geo/2026-01-01 example medevac).

cache_folder.title: Cache folder (advanced)
cache_folder.description: Leave blank. Downloaded terrain, which can grow to a few GB, is kept in your system's cache folder (Library/Caches/sar_geo on a Mac) and downloaded again if deleted.

pin_version.title: Pin version
pin_version.description: Leave blank to always run the newest release. Type a version (for example 0.38.0) to stay on it, such as during an operation.
